data.long_meaning: Eeshal is an Arabic name that refers to a high status or a lofty position. It symbolizes dignity and honor. Parents who choose Eeshal usually hope their child will grow to embody high status and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_arabic.name: عيشال

in_urdu.name: عیشال

in_hindi.name: ईशाल
